goal: Prevent MSVC debug test runs from hanging on assertion popup dialogs in automated setups
Helps developers and external automation running unattended Windows debug builds
reviewability: Author has been silent for months with questions unanswered on whether the change is obsolete
agreement: Objection because the environment variable is undocumented and unused in the repository (fanquake)
Suggested suppressing aborts unconditionally rather than adding an unused variable (hodlinator, sedited)
Questioned if runtime transitions already made this obsolete, with no author reply (fanquake)

categories.name: build
why: P4 because Bitcoin Core does not build with the MSVC debug runtime or set this variable in CI
The benefit is limited entirely to external out-of-tree nightly builds

categories.name: tests
why: P4 because the suppression variable is never enabled within the repository
Offers no benefit to in-tree test runs unless external environments set the variable
